name: Rapamycin (sirolimus)
description: mTOR inhibitor; a prescription immune-suppressing medicine

note.text: Aging trials in people were small, 8 to 48 weeks long. None measured how long people live.

bullets: **Binds FKBP-12;** the complex binds and inhibits mTOR, a key regulatory kinase (label)
**Extended lifespan** in mice fed it from about 600 days of age
**In people,** an effect on aging is not established
Aging: small randomized trials, 25 to 129 people

practical.routes: By mouth (tablets, solution); also IV (Fyarro) and gel (Hyftor)
practical.pharmacokinetics: Peak about 1 to 2 hours (solution); CYP3A4 and P-gp substrate
practical.soldAs: Prescription (Rapamune, generics); compounded in one aging trial
practical.monitored: Sirolimus trough levels, blood fats, kidney protein, infections

regulatory.text: Approved 1999, transplant and LAM; aging off-label
Boxed warning: infection, lymphoma, other cancers

references: FDA, sirolimus tablets prescribing information (DailyMed), Mar 2026
Nature, rapamycin fed late in life extends lifespan in mice, Jul 2009
